text: Work 9 open Q1 (conceptual) questions specs/spec-sgp.md, closing one firm decision grounded published SGP literature, knowledge base research, direct API investigation. made Q1-SGP-9 Q1-SGP-3, leaving 3 questions open (Q1-SGP-3, Q1-SGP-7, Q1-SGP-8).

title: Handoff Summary
text: Q1-SGP-9 (thin history threshold): Minimum 3 complete seasons (n_teams × 3 years — unit error original spec). Basis: Tanner Bell (Smart Fantasy Baseball, 2016) explicitly named 3 seasons floor single-league data noisy. Warning fires < 3 seasons. Q1-SGP-6 (combo stat handling): Direct projection column first; component fallback second (reversed original spec). Rationale: projection sources authoritative. Per-stat: OPS always direct column; SVHD never projection columns — always computed SV + HLD rlang::inform(.frequency = ""); QS direct Steamer/ATC, absent ZiPS (cli_warn() + NA). Q1-SGP-5 (total_sgp aggregation): total_sgp direct sum categories including rate stats. Rate stat SGP standings-point units time ’s returned — deferral par(). total_sgp directly comparable across hitters pitchers; hitter/pitcher budget split dollar_values() concern . Q1-SGP-4 (rate stat SGP method): Dropped "raw_ip" (architecturally wrong — stopped one step producing standings-point units). Replaced two valid methods: "blended_pool" (default — Smart Fantasy Baseball / FanGraphs standard; player blended average team pool) "fixed_baseline" (Zola/Benson/Mosey counting-equivalent; roster-agnostic). tested autoresearch §2e. get_projections() function design: New companion function sgp(). Calls https://www.fangraphs.com/api/projections directly (baseballr projection endpoint). Accepts source string ("steamer", "zips", "atc", "fangraphsdc", "thebat", "thebatx", "custom"). "custom", requires data argument. sgp() always takes data frame — string shortcut inside sgp() . 2023 structural break: Added autoresearch §2f — tests whether pre-2023 seasons truncated just SB also R RBI (shift ban + larger bases affected broader run environment).

title: Handoff Summary
text: Specs: - specs/spec-sgp.md — closed Q1-SGP-9, Q1-SGP-6, Q1-SGP-5, Q1-SGP-4; updated formal definition sgp() rate stat methods; updated total_sgp description; fixed stale assumption row Plans: - plans/autoresearch-valuation.md — added §2e (rate stat SGP method comparison: blended pool vs. fixed baseline), added §2f (2023 structural break scope — replaces old §2e), updated Phase 2 protocol include - plans/get-projections-impl.md — new file — API schema reference get_projections(): function signature, supported sources, FanGraphs API endpoint, output schema, derived column definitions (SVHD, QS), custom projection workflow, links source documentation

text: league_history league_history S3 object plain list $team_season data.frame. data.frame must contain minimum year, team_id, one column per scoring category. Column names case-insensitive; normalized uppercase internally. scoring_categories Character vector category column names, NULL (default) infer league_history$team_season. Explicit specification suppresses inference message recommended production use. n_teams Positive integer NULL (default). NULL, number teams inferred per year row counts; years different counts produce rotostats_warning_uneven_team_counts warning. integer supplied, every year must exactly many rows. years Global calibration window. One : "" (default) — years present league_history. integer vector specific years. year-window helper: (), (), (), last(). Per-category overrides via category_spec take precedence. Years exclude_years removed window applied. weights Global year-weighting scheme. One : weight constructor: flat(), linear_decay(), exp_decay() (default: exp_decay(0.9)). "flat" "linear" character shorthands. Per-category overrides via category_spec take precedence. method Character. Denominator estimation method. One : "ols" (default) — OLS slope standings_position ~ category_total. "gap" — mean adjacent gap sorted team totals. "trimmed_gap" — 10%-trimmed mean adjacent gap. "sd" — sd(totals) * (n - 1) / E[R_n], E[R_n] expected range n standard normals (see expected_range_normal()). category_spec cal_spec() object providing per-category overrides years /weights, NULL (default). Build cal_spec(CAT = cal(years = ..., weights = ...)). outlier_filter Logical. TRUE, team-season rows whose category value falls 1.5 × IQR outside league median category-year excluded fitting. Default: FALSE. exclude_years Integer vector years excluded calibration windows. Default: 2020L (COVID-shortened season). rate_conversion Character. One "blended_pool" (default) "fixed_baseline". "fixed_baseline" path requires league_history already class "sgp_history_transformed"; otherwise calls -yet-implemented convert_rate_stats() stub aborts rotostats_error_not_implemented. roto_pts_col Character. Column name total roto points team_season. Used optional standings validation; part denominator computation. Default: "roto_pts". n_bootstrap Non-negative integer. Number year-level bootstrap replicates CI estimation. 0L (default) disables bootstrapping. positive, year-level percentile bootstrap CIs returned $bootstrap_ci. See Caveats section coverage properties. denom_floor Positive numeric. Near-zero slope guard threshold. abs(weighted_slope) < denom_floor, denominator set Inf rotostats_warning_near_zero_slope warning emitted. Default: 1e-9. ci_level Numeric (0, 1). Bootstrap CI nominal coverage level. Used n_bootstrap > 0. Default: 0.95.

title: Compute SGP denominators for rotisserie scoring categories — sgp_denominators
text: "ols": Fits standings_position ~ category_total via OLS category-year. Standings position direction-aware rank (1 = last place, n = first place). inverse categories (ERA, WHIP) rank flipped — n + 1 - rank(total) — lower totals receive higher rank numbers OLS slope negative. denominator 1 / |weighted_mean_slope|. "gap": Mean adjacent gaps sorted totals, mean(diff(sort(totals))), equivalent range / (n - 1). rank fitting required; sign convention apply. "trimmed_gap": "gap" 10% trimming end gap vector reduce sensitivity outliers. "sd": sd(totals) * (n - 1) / E[R_n], E[R_n] expected range n standard normal variables (see expected_range_normal()). method targets different estimand OLS — output approximately 12x larger typical 12-team leagues. mix OLS SD denominators across categories.

title: Compute SGP denominators for rotisserie scoring categories — sgp_denominators
text: Jensen's-inequality undercoverage bootstrap CIs small n_years. OLS denominator d = 1 / |beta|. inverse convex function, Jensen's inequality implies E[1/|beta|] > 1/E[|beta|], producing small upward bias denominator estimate. n_years = 6 bias approximately 1% true denominator (statistically confirmed sgp-denominators Monte Carlo study). percentile bootstrap CI centered biased estimate rather true denominator, lower CI bound systematically lies truth often, yielding empirical coverage approximately 84-85% nominal 95% n_years <= 6. n_years >= 10 coverage materially better. implementation defect — known property percentile bootstrap upward-biased estimators. Practical guidance: n_years <= 6, treat percentile bootstrap CIs approximate (~10 percentage-point undercoverage). point estimates remain unbiased relative terms (bias < 2% denominator value). tighter coverage required, BCa (bias-corrected accelerated) bootstrap corrects bias planned enhancement. n_years >= 10, percentile CIs adequate applications.

title: rotostats (development version)
text: sgp_denominators() — Calibrates SGP (Standings Gain Points) denominator rotisserie scoring category historical team-season standings. Supports four estimation methods ("ols", "gap", "trimmed_gap", "sd"), per-category calibration overrides via cal_spec(), optional year-level bootstrap CIs. Returns S3 object class "sgp_denominators" fully backward-compatible code treated return value named numeric vector. convert_rate_stats() — Stub; always aborts. Use rate_conversion = "blended_pool" (default) now. Weight constructors: flat(), linear_decay(), exp_decay(). Year-window helpers: (), (), (), last(). Calibration spec constructors: cal(), cal_spec(). expected_range_normal() — Computes E[range] n ..d. standard normals via numerical integration; used internally method = "sd".

title: rotostats (development version)
text: See plans/sgp-denominators-architecture.md full discussion three non-obvious design decisions summarised . Direction-aware rank-flip inverse categories. sgp_denominators() uses rank-1=worst / rank-n=best convention throughout. normal categories (HR, R, RBI, …) rank(total) already gives — higher totals get higher rank numbers OLS slope positive. inverse categories (ERA, WHIP) lower value better, rank(ERA) assign best team rank 1 — wrong end. implementation applies n + 1 - rank(total) OLS fitting, making best ERA team rank n producing negative slope. sign-check warning rotostats_warning_unexpected_slope_sign fires observed slope sign disagrees convention, signalling corrupted mislabelled data. flip lives R/sgp-denominators.R standings_pos computation block, mirrored bootstrap resampling path. .double / .numeric dispatch list S3 objects. .numeric base primitive swallows S3 dispatch list-based objects — .numeric(x) S3 list falls back base coercion silently. .double dispatches correctly. method therefore registered .double.sgp_denominators; .numeric works R’s primitive fallback delegates .double. future list-based S3 classes package follow pattern: register coercions .double, .numeric. See R/sgp-denominators-s3.R ?.double.sgp_denominators. OLS vs. SD estimand distinction. "ols" "sd" methods share estimand. 12-team league σ = 25, OLS denominator converges ≈ 6.7 SD denominator converges ≈ 82 — factor 12. SD formula σ × (n-1) / E[R_n] targets within-year expected gap counting units, whereas OLS targets 1 / |β̂| determined covariance rank total. mix OLS denominators categories SD denominators others league valuation.
